de.my_domain.abalone.model

Class Node

  • java.lang.Object
    • de.my_domain.abalone.model.Node
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Comparable<Node>

    public class Node
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Comparable<Node>
    The Node Wrapper Class. The Node class is used to create a tree of possible moves for the an object of the type Abalone. It saves a Abalone state, children an evaluation. It also provides an min-max-algorithm in order to score the states, such that the machine knows which move is most beneficial for it. It also provides a method to get a hold of exactly this board.

    • Constructor Detail

      • Node

        public Node(Board state)
        This Node constructor returns a new Node object and sets only its state. The children are set to null It also sets the hasChildrenSet flag to false, so that the method setChildren() can be called on the returned object. This constructor is mainly called for constructing a root node.
        Parameters:
        state - Is a object of the type Abalone which saves the current state of the game.

      • Node

        public Node(Board state,
            double evaluation)
        This Node constructor returns a new Node object and sets its state and an evaluation for the given board. The children are set to null. It also sets the hasChildrenSet flag to false, so that the method setChildren() can be called on the returned object.
        Parameters:
        state - Is a object of the type Abalone which saves the current state of the game.
        evaluation - Is an integer value scoring the game. The higher the value, the better is the current state of the game for the machine.

        public void setChildren(java.util.LinkedList<Node> children)
        The setChildren method is the setter method of the children of a Node, such that a single node can become a parent in a tree of nodes. This method is the only way to initialize the attribute children since every constructor sets mentioned attribute to null.
        Parameters:
        children - A LinkedList of objects of the type Node is given to this method, which then sets the list as the children of this.

      • compareTo

        public int compareTo(Node o)
        The compareTo method implements the compareTo method of the interface Comparable. It compares two objects of the type Node for its minMaxEvaluation value.
        Specified by:
        compareTo in interface java.lang.Comparable<Node>
        Parameters:
        o - Is the Node object, the this object is compared with.
        Returns:
        The negative integer -1, 0, or the positive integer 1 as the evaluation of this node is less than, equal to, or greater than the specified node o will be returned.
